# The Columbus Free Press

> > Independent community news and activism platform covering economic justice, grassroots organizing, and social movements in Central Ohio.

Freepress.org serves as the online home of The Columbus Free Press, a community-focused publication dedicated to progressive journalism and local activism. The site provides resources and coverage for community organizing efforts, particularly around economic empowerment and resistance movements in the Columbus area.
